```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "setup_dashboard.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: inject-bivariate-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (explorer_ready) {
  # Variables : registre unique indicator_meta.parquet (80 indicateurs, mêmes que l'Explorer).
  biv_vars <- ind_meta |> dplyr::transmute(field = var, label, group)

  # Seules les métadonnées des variables sont dans la page : les colonnes sont
  # téléchargées à la demande (assets/data/col/<champ>.json, mises en cache).
  biv_vars_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(biv_vars, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  # Palette Stevens 3x3 depuis les tokens ; ordre des classes : (Y1,X1) (Y1,X2) (Y1,X3) (Y2,X1) ...
  biv_palette_ordered <- unname(TOK[paste0("biv-", rep(1:3, each = 3), rep(1:3, times = 3))])
  palette_js    <- jsonlite::toJSON(biv_palette_ordered)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.bivPalette = ', as.character(palette_js), ';\n',
      'window.bivVarMeta = ', as.character(biv_vars_json), ';\n',
      'window.bivLabel = function (f) { var v = window.bivVarMeta.find(function (m) { return m.field === f; }); return v ? v.label : f; };\n',
      '\n',
      '// Construit les 2 menus groupés par thématique (désactivés tant que l\\u2019index charge)\n',
      'window.bivBuildSelectors = function() {\n',
      '  var groups = {};\n',
      '  window.bivVarMeta.forEach(function(v) { (groups[v.group] = groups[v.group] || []).push(v); });\n',
      '  function buildSelect(id, defaultField) {\n',
      '    var sel = document.getElementById(id);\n',
      '    if (!sel || sel._built) return;\n',
      '    sel.innerHTML = "";\n',
      '    Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(g) {\n',
      '      var og = document.createElement("optgroup"); og.label = g;\n',
      '      groups[g].forEach(function(v) {\n',
      '        var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v.field; o.textContent = v.label;\n',
      '        if (v.field === defaultField) o.selected = true;\n',
      '        og.appendChild(o);\n',
      '      });\n',
      '      sel.appendChild(og);\n',
      '    });\n',
      '    sel.addEventListener("change", window.bivRecompute);\n',
      '    sel._built = true;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  buildSelect("biv-x", "elec_pct_rn");\n',
      '  buildSelect("biv-y", "dvf_prix_app");\n',
      '};\n',
      '\n',
      '// Terciles croisés X et Y, puis recoloration de la carte\n',
      'window.bivRecompute = function() {\n',
      '  var xSel = document.getElementById("biv-x"), ySel = document.getElementById("biv-y");\n',
      '  var status = document.getElementById("biv-status");\n',
      '  if (!xSel || !ySel || !CMap.main || !CMap.main._cmapLayers) return;\n',
      '  var xVar = xSel.value, yVar = ySel.value;\n',
      '  xSel.disabled = ySel.disabled = true;\n',
      '  status.textContent = "Chargement des deux indicateurs\u2026";\n',
      '  Promise.all([CMap.data.index(), CMap.data.col(xVar), CMap.data.col(yVar), CMap.index()]).then(function (r) {\n',
      '    var codes = r[0].c, X = r[1], Y = r[2], n0 = codes.length, xs = [], ys = [], i;\n',
      '    for (i = 0; i < n0; i++) if (X[i] != null && Y[i] != null) { xs.push(X[i]); ys.push(Y[i]); }\n',
      '    xSel.disabled = ySel.disabled = false;\n',
      '    if (xs.length < 30) { status.textContent = "Pas assez de communes (" + xs.length + ") pour cette paire."; return; }\n',
      '    xs.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}); ys.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});\n',
      '    var n = xs.length, xT1 = xs[Math.floor(n/3)], xT2 = xs[Math.floor(2*n/3)], yT1 = ys[Math.floor(n/3)], yT2 = ys[Math.floor(2*n/3)];\n',
      '    var cls = {}, vx = {}, vy = {};\n',
      '    for (i = 0; i < n0; i++) {\n',
      '      if (X[i] == null || Y[i] == null) continue;\n',
      '      var xb = X[i] < xT1 ? 1 : (X[i] < xT2 ? 2 : 3), yb = Y[i] < yT1 ? 1 : (Y[i] < yT2 ? 2 : 3);\n',
      '      cls[codes[i]] = (yb - 1) * 3 + xb; vx[codes[i]] = X[i]; vy[codes[i]] = Y[i];\n',
      '    }\n',
      '    var ix = r[3], cN = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], cP = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], totP = 0, k;\n',
      '    for (k = 0; k < ix.metro.length; k++) { var pp = ix.metro[k], cc = cls[ix.codes[pp]], pw = ix.pop[pp] > 0 ? ix.pop[pp] : 0; totP += pw; if (cc) { cN[cc-1]++; cP[cc-1] += pw; } }\n',
      '    var xl = window.bivLabel(xVar), yl = window.bivLabel(yVar);\n',
      '    CMap.recolor({ get: function (c) { return cls[c] || null; }, levels: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].map(String), palette: window.bivPalette,\n',
      '      tip: function (c, v) { return v == null ? "Non croisée (une des deux valeurs manque)" :\n',
      '        xl + " : " + CMap.fmt(vx[c], 2) + " \u00b7 " + yl + " : " + CMap.fmt(vy[c], 2); },\n',
      '      legend: { title: "" } });\n',
      '    status.textContent = CMap.fmt(n, 0) + " communes croisées sur " + CMap.fmt(n0, 0);\n',
      '    var html = "<div class=\\"biv-legend\\"><div class=\\"biv-legend-title\\">Terciles croisés</div><div class=\\"biv-grid-wrap\\"><div class=\\"biv-yarrow\\">\u2191 " + CMap.esc(yl) + "</div><div class=\\"biv-grid\\">";\n',
      '    for (var by = 3; by >= 1; by--) for (var bx = 1; bx <= 3; bx++) {\n',
      '      var q = (by-1)*3 + bx - 1; html += "<div class=\\"biv-cell\\" title=\\"" + CMap.fmt(cN[q], 0) + " communes, " + CMap.fmt(totP ? 100 * cP[q] / totP : 0, 1) + " % de la population\\" style=\\"background:" + window.bivPalette[q] + "\\"></div>";\n',
      '    }\n',
      '    html += "</div></div><div class=\\"biv-xarrow\\">" + CMap.esc(xl) + " \u2192</div><div class=\\"biv-na\\"><i></i>Non croisée</div></div>";\n',
      '    document.getElementById("biv-legend").innerHTML = html;\n',
      '  }).catch(function (e) { console.error(e); status.textContent = "Données indisponibles."; xSel.disabled = ySel.disabled = false; });\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

  </div>
  <div class="dvf-ctrl-group">
    <label class="dvf-ctrl-label" for="biv-y">Axe Y</label>

</div>
<div id="biv-legend" class="biv-legend-container"></div>

```{r}
#| label: map-bivariate
if (explorer_ready) {
  m <- cmap_widget(com_metro_only, dep_metro, fill = rep(NA_character_, nrow(com_metro_only)),
                   tip = NULL)
  cmap_on_render(m, "
    window.bivMap = self;
    window.bivBuildSelectors();
    var xs = document.getElementById('biv-x'), ys = document.getElementById('biv-y');
    xs.disabled = ys.disabled = true;
    self.on('cmap:ready', function () { window.bivRecompute(); });
  ")
}
```
:::
